samples.name: character-citizen-male-1-fish-frame-1
samples.prompt: Exactly ONE young Slavic peasant character in ONE fishing pose holding ONE simple wooden fishing rod with short visible line. NOT a sprite sheet. Same character as first reference: short brown hair, belted kosovorotka, trousers, bast shoes. Other references define chunky minimal Kenney pixel art. Transparent 16x16 logical pixel canvas enlarged nearest-neighbor. Body centered, south-facing slight overhead view, feet at bottom, all rod and line inside canvas. Rod and line must be solid one-logical-pixel thick so they survive at 16x16. Flat colors: skin #f7c282/#e19a65, hair #bd6c4a/#763b36, clothes #c0cbdc/#8b9bb4/#52607c, warm brown rod, muted grey line. No gradients, texture, antialiasing, glow, shadow, water, ground, scenery, fish, text or other people. Waiting pose: hands at waist grip rod angled upward to screen-right, rod tip gently curved, short line hanging down at right edge.
